title: CSCI 453 — Computer Architecture
subject: Computer Systems
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define and explain the core components of a processor architecture, including registers, instruction sets, and memory hierarchy.
Differentiate between user mode and privileged kernel mode, and describe how system calls and traps facilitate secure hardware interaction.
Apply architectural concepts to simulate processor behavior, demonstrating how design choices impact performance and resource management.
